hero.title: Get Placement Ready
hero.description: Saksham is your AI companion that simulates real hiring experiences, identifies skill gaps, and accelerates your journey to employment.

items.title: Unclear Skill Readiness
items.description: Students lack visibility into their specific strengths and weaknesses, making it difficult to focus their efforts effectively.

items.title: Fragmented Preparation
items.description: Learning resources are scattered across platforms without structured guidance, creating an overwhelming experience.

items.title: Manual Job Discovery
items.description: Students spend hours searching and applying manually for relevant jobs, often missing opportunities that match their skills.

solution.title: One AI Platform
solution.description: Saksham seamlessly integrates assessment, skill enhancement, and job placement into a unified AI-driven pipeline for maximum efficiency.

items.title: AI Resume Parser
items.description: Effortlessly upload or generate professional resumes with intelligent AI assistance for optimal formatting and content.

items.title: Job Role Recommendation
items.description: Intelligent matching of user profiles to ideal career roles based on skills, experience, and market trends.

items.title: Placement Simulation
items.description: Realistic multi-round interview simulations to prepare users for actual placement processes.

items.title: AI Evaluation Engine
items.description: Advanced real-time scoring, detailed insights, and comprehensive readiness analytics for skill assessment.

items.title: Curated Learning Feed
items.description: Personalized auto-generated learning playlists targeting identified weak areas for efficient skill improvement.

items.title: Smart Job Agent
items.description: Automated application to suitable job openings when user's readiness score reaches or exceeds 50%.

journey.title: Your AI-Driven
journey.description: Follow this seamless 7-step journey - from uploading your resume to automated job applications.

steps.title: Upload Resume
steps.description: AI instantly extracts your skills, education, and experience from your resume.

steps.title: View Job Suggestions
steps.description: Discover personalized job roles that match your skills and career goals.

steps.title: Enter Simulation
steps.description: Experience realistic AI-powered aptitude and technical interview rounds.

steps.title: Instant Insights
steps.description: Receive detailed readiness reports and scores across all categories.

steps.title: Learning Playlist
steps.description: Get curated tutorials and resources to improve your skill gaps.

steps.title: Track Progress
steps.description: Monitor your improvement after multiple simulated attempts.

steps.title: Auto Applications
steps.description: AI applies to relevant job openings once your readiness reaches ≥50%.

advantages.description: Discover how AI-driven insights and personalized recommendations prepare you for real interviews and accelerate your career success.

items.title: Real-Time AI Evaluation
items.description: Each simulation is scored via domain-trained neural models for accurate and real-time performance insights.

items.title: Personalized Learning Recommendations
items.description: Weak areas are automatically identified, and dynamic playlists are curated from trusted public repositories.

items.title: Automated Career Progression
items.description: When you're ready, AI matches and applies to suitable roles instantly-saving you time and effort.

analytics.description: Track your progress with AI-driven insights. From readiness evaluation to skill assessment and improvement, get a clear picture of your journey and excel in your career.
